headline: Singapore's SATS Asks Staff to Volunteer for Baggage Handling Amid MOM Probe
summary: SATS asked employees to volunteer for temporary baggage-handling duties, offering NTUC vouchers, time off, and transport allowances, while facing an ongoing probe by the Ministry of Manpower.
why: Ground handling and logistics providers are sensitive to labor availability and regulatory compliance, which can directly affect operational efficiency and cost structures.

impacts.name: SATS Ltd
impacts.why: SATS faces operational adjustments and a labor ministry probe.
